propositions: Duplicate tickets with identical titles are filed and discovered mid-implementation because no create-time detection exists; the overlap detector runs at plan-review time per ADR 0086, not at write time

A bounded O(window) advisory-only same-title duplicate warning should surface at creation (not blocking), reusing a 600-second rolling sidecar journal of recent creates probed under fcntl.flock serialization

The probe runs inside create_core when verify.suggest_duplicate_tickets is true, returning a duplicate_warning key surfaced on CLI stderr (both composer.py and idea_cli), library result dict, and MCP CreateResultOut

Same-title detection is normalized (case, punctuation, whitespace folded) and bounded to 600s recency window; measured data showed all 7 true same-title duplicates were created within 171s of each other, achieving 100% precision in a constrained window
The feature must never block creation (exit 0, ticket succeeds) and must degrade gracefully if the journal is unreadable or config fails, ensuring an advisory never fails a completed write
